markers.interpretation: Vitamin D pathway variants can contextualize immune tone, but thyroid antibody status and actual 25(OH)D levels are more informative than genotype.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Vitamin D pathway effects depend on sun exposure, intake, adiposity, liver/kidney conversion, and inflammation.

markers.impact: Estrogen effects on thyroid-binding globulin and symptom interpretation
markers.interpretation: Estrogen status can change thyroid-binding globulin and total thyroid hormone levels. This matters for cycle, pregnancy, oral estrogen, and hormone therapy interpretation but is not a genotype-only trait.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Hormone exposure and binding proteins are not measured by raw DNA.
